text: Hey team, quick question—who actually needs to sign off if we’re doing a discount over 40% on a multi-year public sector renewal? I can’t find anything clear in the handbook.

Hey Luis! Yeah, that’s not in the handbook yet, but for anything above 40% on multi-year public sector deals, you need to get approval from both the regional VP and finance. There’s an internal form we use—shoot me a DM and I’ll send you the link. Just make sure you loop in finance early, they’re pretty strict on these.
Thanks Lena! Is that the same form as for the standard discount approvals, or a different one?
It’s a different one—looks almost the same but there’s a section for multi-year justification. I’ll send it over. Let me know if you need help filling it out.
